1.
  An adjourned meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Kendrick at 2: 00 p. m .
2.  Council Members  present:  Mayor pon Kendrick
  Mayor Pro Tem  Charlie Rosales
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Muir Davis
  Council Mem ber Tim Hepburn

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Manager/ Public Works Director Dan Keesey
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer

3.  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Kendrick.
4.  Closed Session/ Meritage  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATIQN
  Homes of California
  The City Council met in a closed  pursuant to Government Code
  session,
  54956. 9 ( a)( d) ( 1 ), to discuss Meritage Homes of California v.
  City of
  La Verne, Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. BS 172622.

  It was moved  by Carder and seconded by Rosales, and unanimously
  carried to approve a Settlement with Meritage Homes of California.

5.  At 2: 20 pm .,
  the City Council recessed to start interviews of the Planning Commission Applicants.
6.  Planning Commission  At its adjourned meeting of June 17, 2019, the City Council heard from the
  Applicants Interviews  Planning Commission Applicants who gave a three ( 3) minute presentation for
  the two vacancies on the Planning Commission.
  After the presentation City
  Council selected 10 applicants to interview.  Appointment of the two (2) new
  Planning Commissioners  will  be at the July 15, 2019,  City Council Meeting.

  The City Council interviewed the following Planning Commission Applicants:
  Brian Bowcock
  J effry AI I red
  Thomas Allison
  Brian Melkesian
  Kathy Kalousek

  After interviewing the above applicants, the City Council recessed to meet
  again on  Tuesday, June 25, 2019, at 2: 00 pm , to interview the next five
  applicants.
   Adjourned  Meeting, City Council  Minutes,  Monday, June 24, 2019, Page 2

7.  Public Comment
  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items  not  listed in any other  place  on  the agenda.  Mayor Kendrick called for
  public  comment.

  There was none.

9.  At 5: 20 pm, the City Council  recessed  to Tuesday, June 25, 2019, at 2: 00 pm, in the Conference Room of
  La Verne  City Hall, for City Council to continue Interviews of Planning Commission Applicants.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Robert Russi,
  City Manager
